gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-87.654322 40.146491)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 60 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH target_poi AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-87.654322, 40.146491), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_below_60 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    rast,
    ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(target_poi.geom, 3857), 100000) -- buffer to include nearby terrain
  )
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
    dem_below_60.rast,
    true,
    ST_Buffer(target_poi.geom, 100000)::geometry
  ) AS rast
  FROM dem_below_60, target_poi
),
terrain_below_60 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
  WHERE ST_BandMaxValue(rast) < 60
),
nearest_distance AS (
  SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(
    target_poi.geom,
    ST_Centroid(ST_Union(ST_PixelAsPoints(terrain_below_60.rast, 1)))
  )) AS distance_meters
  FROM target_poi, terrain_below_60
)
SELECT ROUND(distance_meters) AS distance_to_terrain_below_60_meters
FROM nearest_distance;
